MIND. [1] [Arg. m.]
Mania.
Delirious rage, after epileptic attacks.
In society indisposed to talk ; he complains of rush of blood to head and cheeks, singing in ears ; itching in reddened eyes.
Anxious about her health ; full of care. θ Laryngitis.
Displeased, aversion to talk. θ Exostosis of skull.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Arg. m.]
Dizziness on entering a room after a walk ; before midnight, while slumbering in bed, it seemed as if head was falling out of bed ; followed by a violent convulsive starting of body.
Felt suddenly giddy, and as if a mist was before eyes.
Attacks of vertigo ; he cannot think rightly.
When looking at running water, giddy.
A crawling and whirling in head, as if drunken.
Complete dizziness on entering room after a walk.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Arg. m.]
Frontal headache of business men.
Pressing pain, with dulness in forehead, and drawing pressure in occiput.
Painful sensation of emptiness in head, feeling as if it was hollow, with aching of whole brain. θ Exostosis of skull.
Left-sided headache, as if in brain substance ; at first only slight drawing, but gradually becoming more violent ; at its culmination raging as though a nerve was being torn, ceasing suddenly.
Dull, pressive, persistent headache, encircles the calvarium like a wreath.
Bad effects of sunstroke.
Headache and dyspepsias induced by mental agitation, nursing sick, etc.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Arg. m.]
Pressing, tearing pain in skull, principally in temporal bones, renewed every day at noon, < by pressure and touch, > in open air.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Arg. m.]
Sight very weak.
Amaurosis of left eye, contracted pupil, insensible to light.
Violent itching of lids and corners of eyes. θ Blepharitis.
Lids greatly swollen and thickened ; margins thick and red.
Pustules along edges of lids after measles. θ Blepharitis.
Any effort to separate lids causes their edges to be drawn in ; lids raw, sore, red, slightly everted, without smarting or pain. θ Blepharitis.
Stricture of lachrymal duct.
Infant, æt. 4 weeks ; since third and fourth day, abundant purulent discharge, pus oozing in jets, lids could not be separated ; alarmingly swollen and thickened ; after Sulphur and Calc. carb., Arg. met. [2c] every four hours ; next day to the mother at lengthening intervals.
Affections of tarsal cartilages.
Inflammation of left eye with lachrymation, great intolerance of daylight and running at nose ; after many medicines attacking right eye, pain was shooting, itching, aching ; sometimes very violent, also without corresponding amount of redness. θ After measles.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Arg. m.]
Buzzings in ears, with ebullitions and heat. θ Palpitation of heart.
Corrosive itching ; scratching until bleeding ensues.
Itching, warmth and formication of concha.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Arg. m.]
Tickling, crawling sensation in nose, followed by nosebleed.
Nosebleed, with tickling, crawling sensation in nose.
Violent fluent coryza, with frequent sneezing.
Most exhausting fluent coryza, with sneezing. θ Exostosis on skull.
Affections of nasal cartilages.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Arg. m.]
Great redness of face. θ Exostosis on skull.
Pale and earthy face. θ Diabetes mellitus.
Face straw-colored, down to lips inclusive. θ Scirrhus of os uteri.
Sudden heat in face. θ Palpitation of heart.
Burning itching of face.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Arg. m.]
Fetid breath. θ Scirrhous uteri.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Arg. m.]
Sore throat as from swelling of pharynx. θ Exostosis on skull.
Region of submaxillary glands swollen ; neck stiff ; swallowing difficult, as from internal swelling ; has to force every mouthful down œsophagus.
Scratching sensation in soft palate, as from something rough sticking there ; felt most during empty swallowing, forcing him to swallow saliva.
Painful tension in fauces, as from swelling, when yawning.
Throat feels raw and sore during expiration, or when swallowing or coughing.
Viscid, grey, jelly-like mucus in pharynx, easily hawked up ; early morning.
Anesthesia of fauces. θ Diphtheria.
Throat aches more with coughing than with swallowing, notwithstanding that food goes down with difficulty. θ Exostosis on skull.
A thick, viscous saliva sticks to hard palate, causes a scratching.
Mercurial angina.
Tension in fauces on right side, felt only when gaping. θ Aphonia.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Arg. m.]
Great hunger. θ Exostosis on skull.
Hungry in morning, giving her nausea. θ Palpitation.
Appetite pretty good. θ Scirrhous uteri.
At times loss of appetite, with aversion to smoking, for a long time.
Aversion to all food, even when thinking of it.
Want of thirst, even during hot stage of fever.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Arg. m.]
After dinner : nosebleed ; dry stool.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Arg. m.]
Digestion took place without pain in stomach. θ Scirrhous uteri.
Oppression in scrobiculum. θ Diabetes mellitus.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Arg. m.]
Expansion and sensation of fulness in epigastrium, with hunger.
Wind colic.
Every moment lancinating pain in hypogastrium, like pin-pricks. θ Scirrhous uteri.
Distension of hypogastrium ; which was exceedingly sensitive to contact. θ Scirrhous uteri.
Bruised pain over left hip, and on whole left side of pelvis, with uterine weakness.
Painful soreness in whole abdomen, < when riding in a carriage. θ With uterine complaints.
Tendency to crampy pains in groins. Scirrhus uteri.
Sweat only on abdomen and on chest.
Sweat on abdomen. θ Exostosis on skull.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Arg. m.]
Soft, but scanty stool. θ Exostosis on skull.
Frequent urging in lower part of rectum, with discharge of small quantities of soft stool.
Dry stool, like sand, after dinner.
Alvine evacuation irregular, often lienteric diarrhœa. θ Scirrhous uteri.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Arg. m.]
Passed five or six pints of urine in one night. θ Diabetes mellitus.
Urine turbid, sweetish, profuse at night. θ Diabetes.
Profuse urine.
Urination copious. θ Diphtheria ; scirrhous uteri, etc.
Polyuria.
Urine like whey, slightly turbid, of a sweet taste. θ Diabetes mellitus.
Urine pale, fetid, profuse, especially at night. θ Scirrhous uteri.
Enuresis nocturna, spasmodic form.
Albuminuria.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Arg. m.]
Yellowish-greenish gonorrhœa, of an indolent character from beginning ; of eight months' standing.
Very profuse gonorrhœal discharge, with contusive pain in testicle.
Crushed pain in testicles ; clothing increases pain on walking ; also evening in bed.
Scrotum and feet œdematous. θ Diabetes mellitus.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Arg. m.]
Prolapsus, with pain in left ovary.
Pain in left ovary and back, extending to front and downward. θ Prolapsus.
Pains in left ovary and loins.
Purulent, ichorous, sometimes bloody matter flows from uterine ulcers, filling room with unbearable stench. θ Scirrhus.
Neck of uterus looks spongy, deeply corroded ; face straw-colored ; bruised, tense feeling in groin ; urine copious ; cramps in thighs.
Prolapsus uteri ; pain in left ovary ; pain in small of back, extending to front and downward.
Sore feeling, as if ulcerated, in whole abdomen, < when riding in a carriage. θ Uterine diseases.
Mucous membrane of vagina wrinkled by descent of uterus. θ Scirrhous uteri.
Purulent, ichorous, horribly smelling and at times bloody matter filled vagina. θ Scirrhous uteri.
Ulcers of uterus discharging purulent, ichorous matter, sometimes bloody water, with unbearable stench. θ Prolapsus uteri.
Neck of uterus very much swollen, presented a spongy mass, deeply corroded with ulcers in different directions, it was impossible to discorver the os tincæ.
In less than three days foul smell was lost almost entirely. θ Scirrhus of os tincæ.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Arg. m.]
Palpitation during pregnancy.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Arg. m.]
Hoarseness ; especially of professional singers, speakers, etc.
Total loss of voice with professional singers.
Very hoarse, cannot speak a loud word. θ Laryngitis.
Hoarseness, aggravated by speaking for a length of time.
Cannot speak a loud word ; constant tickling in throat, provoking cough. θ Laryngitis.
The sounds in singing came double.
Alteration in timbre of voice with singers, speakers and preachers, with feeling of constriction and rawness in larynx.
Aphonia after angina, cannot sing, and when gaping he feels a tension in throat.
The cricoid cartilage is painful, with a bruised sensation to slightest touch, and a feeling as if stopped up with a foreign body.
Rawness and soreness in upper part of larynx, when coughing, not when swallowing.
Laughing produces mucus in larynx and excites cough.
A grey, gelatinous phlegm is easily raised from trachea.
Over bifurcation of trachea, a raw spot ; < when using voice, talking or singing.
Eating apples, small piece seemed to stick in larynx, leaving a spot which feels cool, irritates to cough, which does not lessen the sensation.
A dull cutting pain rises in trachea, becomes a shooting, inducing single coughs. θ Laryngitis.
Chronic inflammation of larynx with a teacher ; 3d followed by 2e.
A roughness and soreness in larynx when coughing, not when swallowing. θ Laryngitis.
A soreness "at bottom of windpipe."
Phthisis laryngea ; clergymen, singers, public speakers, etc.
Foul breath. θ Scirrhus of os uteri.
When reading aloud in evening, he has to hem and hawk.
Stitches between sixth and seventh rib, < when inhaling.
Want of breath. Diabetes.
Deep sighing inhalations relieve the palpitation.
Laughing causes cough ; mucus in larynx. θ Laryngitis.
   

COUGH. [27] [Arg. m.]
Attacks of cough from laughing.
Complains about a constant tickling in throat setting her to coughing. θ Laryngitis.
Dull cutting, becoming a shooting, rising up in trachea and forcing him to single coughs.
Cough in attacks, rattling by day and in room, not at night nor in open air.
Cough with easy expectoration, white, thickish, looking like boiled starch.
Expectoration almost constant, day and evening.
When coughing, a raw sore feeling in throat, not in windpipe, also not when swallowing.
Dry cough and easy expectoration.
Sputa like gelatin and grey.
Much grey, gelatinous phlegm in trachea, easily expectorated. θ Exostosis on skull.
Sputa easy, white, thick, like boiled starch. θ Laryngitis.
The cough is accompanied with an easy expectoration of white, thick, starch-like mucus, without taste or smell.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Arg. m.]
Stitches in right chest from within outward ; he can neither inhale nor exhale.
Violent pain in chest and shoulders pressing inward, returning every Winter.
Great weakness of chest, < left side, as a concomitant to other symptoms.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Arg. m.]
Sensation as if heart suddenly was standing still, followed by a trembling at heart, gradually passing into an irregular throbbing, disappearing after a few minutes. θ During pregnancy.
Frequent palpitation with or without anxiety.
During pregnancy, increasing palpitation.
During day or night frequent attacks of violent palpitation of heart, with or without feeling of anxiety. θ Third month of pregnancy.
Trembling and palpitation of heart.
Heartbeats sometimes omit.
Full feeling in region of heart.
Frequent, spasmodic, though painless twitchings of whole cardiac muscle, especially on lying on back ; fears apoplexy.
Pulse intermitting and very irregular during attacks of palpitation.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Arg. m.]
Chest feels sore to touch.
Boil near last rib.
Sweat on chest. θ Exostosis on skull.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Arg. m.]
Chill spreads from back.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Arg. m.]
Inflammation of arms.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Arg. m.]
Crampy pains in thighs from time to time. θ Scirrhus of os uteri.
From time to time crampy pains in thighs. θ Scirrhous os uteri.
Calves feel as if too short on going down-stairs.
When stepping, feet feel sore, as if ulcerated.
Feet œdematous, swollen. θ Diabetes mellitus.
Tearing in feet, at times in soles, dorsum, heels or toes, in tarsal or metatarsal bones.
Lower limbs sometimes, especially in morning after rising, become so weak and trembling that knees knock together. θ Palpitation.
In left knee, when moving it, a pain as if beaten and as if out of joint, like after much walking. θ Palpitation.
Left lower limb gets stiff and immovable, as if asleep. θ Palpitation.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Arg. m.]
Numbness in limbs, as if asleep.
Loss of power ; after walking unusual fatigue ; heaviness.
Joints of hands and feel sore ; drawing in joints.
Burning, lancinating pain, like sting of a wasp at knee and elbow, < at the latter.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Arg. m.]
Worse lying on her back. θ Palpitation.
Lying : on back brings on attack of palpitation or increases it, also twitching of cardiac muscles.
Sitting : pains in back and limbs increase ; pains in knees.
Motion : paralytic weakness ; much inclined to move, feels as if she had more power ; pains in menorrhagia ; bruised pain in back, loins and neck <.
Stooping : mucus in air passages ; stitches in left ribs.
   

NERVES. [36] [Arg. m.]
After dinner, during siesta, a violent electric shock, first proceeds from left afterwards from right hip joint, disturbing sleep ; having fallen asleep again (ten minutes), with hands above head, another shock, much more violent in left arm, proceeds from arm joint.
Convulsive shocks of whole body ; after previous vertigo ; mostly when dropping off to sleep, preventing sleep.
Epileptic attacks, followed by delirious rage, jumping about, striking those near.
Paralytic weakness on motion ; bruised feeling.
Paralytic weakness, with all pains.
Legs weak and trembling, mostly in morning after rising ; knees give way. θ Palpitation of heart.
Sudden weakness, as if he should break down. θ Palpitation of heart.
Very much prostrated. θ Diabetes mellitus.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Arg. m.]
In bed, while slumbering, seized with a dizziness, as if head fell out of bed ; followed by a violent, convulsive starting of body ; vertigo and desire to sleep had disappeared.
Cannot fall asleep easily, and her sleep is very restless ; as soon as she sinks into a doze, an electric shock of whole body or single limbs occurs and interrupts sleep. θ Palpitation.
Restless sleep ; anxious, frightful dreams, on awaking believes them true ; also in cases of palpitation of heart.
Nausea in dreams ; seminal emissions.
On awaking : fatigue ; upper arm weak ; legs powerless.
Many anxious dreams with screaming. θ Palpitation.
No rest at night, has to urinate so often. θ Diabetes mellitus.
   

TIME. [38] [Arg. m.]
In morning : weary in all limbs ; sneezing ; mucus in throat ; pulse slower ; hips stiff ; nausea.
Evening : mind depressed, sad ; pains in limbs ; crushed pain in testes ; two tones in larynx while inspiring ; hoarse reading ; pulse increased.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Arg. m.]
After effects of sunstroke.
   

FEVER. [40] [Arg. m.]
Chill before midnight, every time bedclothes are raised.
Heat of body, except head, with thirst. θ Exostoses on skull.
Heat in forenoon, over whole body, but less on head.
Hectic, 11 A. M. to 12, or 1 P. M. θ In laryngeal and bronchial troubles.
Sweats easily ; during and after eating ; upper part of body, or only front of body.
Sweat on abdomen, chest.
Oily sweat on abdomen or chest.
   

ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Arg. m.]
Paroxysms of burning in corns.
Symptoms reappear at noon.
Attacks brought on by lying on back. θ Palpitation.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Arg. m.]
Left : cutting into brain from ear ; temple ; headache ; amaurosis ; nostril throbs ; cheek throbs ; molar aches ; cutting under ribs ; arm as if beaten ; over pelvis, bruised ; ovary, cartilages, false ribs ; shocks in arm ; paralytic drawing in upper arm, wrist ; patella.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Arg. m.]
Acts on all cartilages.
Joints feel weak, sore ; especially on descending.
Joints feel as if beaten. θ Exostosis on skull.
Emaciation. θ Diabetes mellitus.
Drawing pressure or tearing in bones, especially long bones.
Articular rheumatism without swelling.
Caries.
Tearing pain in bones. θ Exostosis on skull.
Tenderness, tearing pressure and pain in bones.
Copious discharge of mucus ; of pus ; of urine.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Arg. m.]
Worse riding in carriage : painful soreness of whole abdomen, also uterine complaints.
Worse when touched : pain in muscles of upper arm ; bones of thumb and last phalanges of both big toes.
When pressed upon, parts feel sore as if bruised.
Every step hurts in hip joint.
   

SKIN. [46] [Arg. m.]
Eruptions feel sore as if excoriated.
Purulent, ichorous, sometimes bloody matter flowing from ulcers, constantly filled the vagina, from which proceeded a horrible stench, driving all from room. θ Scirrhus of os tincæ.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Arg. m.]
Woman, æt. 28, choleric, black eyes and hair ; pregnant in fourth mouth. θ Palpitation.
Affections from onanism.
Woman, æt. 50, tall, thin, emaciated, very irritable temperament. θ Scirrhus of neck of uterus.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Arg. m.]
Ailments from abuse of mercury.
